cohort: Danish mothers and children with AATD from 1973 to 2013 (n = 559 cases)
finding: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency was found to be associated with an increased risk of adverse birth outcomes, including term low birth weight, smaller abdominal circumference, cesarean section delivery, preterm birth, and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to be associated with AATD.
